pdf.section: 16. Other, large number of cheque deposits
pdf.scope: Current general banking tariff. The PDF's 2026-11-16 future securities notice does not change this cheque-deposit row. Month of booklet version is not an independently evidenced fee commencement day.

tariff.appliesTo: One additional local USD clearing cheque deposited into the selected personal BOCHK account

exclusions: No blanket unlimited free deposits; the withdrawal calculator covers one cheque, not the cumulative fee for all earlier daily cheques.
Do not apply foreign-cheque collection, purchased bills or corporate direct-debit transaction fees to a local USD clearing cheque.
Do not copy SC's pre-filled deposit slip discount or ICBC Asia's HKD 2 excess price to BOCHK.
Do not copy this allowance to HSBC One or Hang Seng.
